evidence_cards.title: Corrected indirect randomized Dato evidence
evidence_cards.text: TROPION-Lung01 was a randomized comparison of Dato-DXd monotherapy versus docetaxel after prior NSCLC therapy. Table 2 reports 234 patients per arm in the nonsquamous histology efficacy subgroup, not 229 versus 232. Median PFS was 5.5 versus 3.6 months, HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.51-0.79). In the overall population, OS was not significantly improved: HR 0.94 (95% CI 0.78-1.14), p=0.530. Histology subgroups used electronic case-report-form data. These patients do not isolate AVANZAR TROP2-positive disease. Treatment line, combination, comparator and hypothesis differ; neither the PFS signal nor the overall OS null result establishes AVANZAR efficacy.

evidence_cards.title: Indirect open-label riliprubart CIDP week-24 evidence
evidence_cards.text: Sanofi reported an open-label, multicentre phase 2 CIDP study without a randomized comparator. At week 24, 42/48 SOC-treated patients (87%), 16/18 SOC-refractory patients (89%) and 11/12 SOC-naive patients (92%) improved or remained stable. Improvement alone occurred in 25/48 treated patients (52%) and 9/18 refractory patients (50%). These combined stable-or-improved proportions are not one shared primary response endpoint: Part A primary was relapse after SOC withdrawal for treated patients, and response during treatment for refractory/naive patients. Part B was an optional 52-week extension whose primary endpoint was long-term safety/tolerability. Two deaths occurred in patients with significant comorbidities; the release does not establish drug causality. SOC included immunoglobulins or corticosteroids. Nonrandomization, cohort differences, endpoint differences and selected extension participation prevent an estimate of superiority over maintenance IVIg in VITALIZE.

evidence_cards.title: Conditional open-label riliprubart CIDP week-76 evidence
evidence_cards.text: Sanofi's December 2025 presentation reports phase 2 CIDP extension outcomes at week 76 only among patient groups who achieved the week-24 primary endpoint. The conditional cohorts were SOC-treated n=40, SOC-refractory n=9 and SOC-naive n=7: 80% were relapse-free, 78% had sustained response and 86% had sustained response, respectively. Non-evaluable proportions were 13%, 11% and 14%; reported relapse proportions were 7% and 11% in the first two groups. These are open-label conditional extension outcomes, not percentages of the original 48/18/12 cohorts and not randomized treatment effects. They support potential durability in selected responders but cannot estimate VITALIZE week-24 adjusted-INCAT superiority against maintenance IVIg. Part B's primary endpoint was long-term safety/tolerability, as defined in the 2024 study description.
